privacy.metaDescription: How the NEXUS app collects, uses, and protects your data.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At NEXUS, we take your privacy seriously. This page explains what information we collect, how we use it, and when we share it.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: We collect account details (name, email, phone number), fitness data (workouts, weight, body measurements, nutrition plans, and — with your permission — your step count and other health readings; see the next section), usage data (how you interact with the app), and payment data — processed entirely through Stripe; we never store your card numbers on our servers.

sections.heading: Health and Fitness Data
sections.body: With your permission, NEXUS reads your daily step count — either from your phone's built-in motion sensor, or from Apple Health / Health Connect if you connect them. If you connect a watch or a health app, we may also read your heart rate, sleep, and active calories burned. This data is used only to show your own progress and to calculate your fitness score inside the app. We never sell it, never use it for advertising, and never share it with advertisers or data brokers. Your daily step totals are stored on your device and with your account so your charts survive reinstalling the app. You can revoke the motion or health permission at any time in your phone's settings — the rest of the app keeps working, and those figures simply stop updating. Deleting your account deletes this data with it.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use your data to provide and improve our services, personalize your AI Coach plans, enable communication with your coach or gym, process payments and subscriptions, and send important account-related notifications.

sections.heading: Sharing Your Information
sections.body: We share your data with your coach or the gym you're enrolled with (if any), and trusted service providers we rely on to run the app (such as Stripe for payments and Google Gemini for AI Coach analysis). We do not sell your personal data. We do share device identifiers with our advertising partners, as described in the Advertising section below.

sections.heading: Advertising
sections.body: The app displays ads served by Google AdMob. Google and its partners may use your device's advertising identifier, your IP address (to estimate a coarse location), and data about how you interact with the app and with ads — to serve ads, measure their performance, and prevent fraud. On iOS we ask for your permission through the App Tracking Transparency prompt before the advertising identifier is used; if you decline, the app keeps working in full with non-personalised ads. Users in the European Economic Area are shown a consent form before any ad loads. You can review how Google uses this data at policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites

sections.heading: Data Security
sections.body: We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, loss, or misuse. That said, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.

sections.heading: Data Retention and Deletion
sections.body: We keep your account data (profile, workouts and plans, weight and measurements, step totals and health readings) for as long as your account is active, because the app needs it to show your progress and let your coach follow it. We do not delete inactive accounts automatically; your data stays until you delete your account or ask us to. Your location is read on your device only, to check that you are inside your gym, and is never stored or sent to our servers. Group notifications sent by your gym are removed from the history automatically after 30 days. We never store payment card numbers (Stripe processes them); records of subscriptions and payments may be kept after your account is deleted for as long as accounting and tax obligations require. When you delete your account inside the app (Settings → Account → Delete account), we immediately delete your profile, all data linked to it, your gym membership link and your sign-in account. If you can't sign in, email us from your registered address and we will delete it within 30 days at most. The service providers we use (such as Google Firebase) may keep technical logs and backups for a limited period under their own policies before they are permanently erased.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.body: You can request access to your data, correct it, export it, or delete your account entirely at any time. See our Account Deletion page for full details.

sections.heading: Children's Privacy
sections.body: The app is not directed at children under 16, and we do not knowingly collect data from this age group.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this policy from time to time. We'll notify you of any material changes through the app or by email.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.body: For any privacy-related question, reach out via the email address at the bottom of this page.

terms.metaDescription: The terms and conditions governing the use of the NEXUS app and services.
terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By using the NEXUS app or website, you agree to the following terms. Please read them carefully.

sections.heading: Acceptance of Terms
sections.body: Using the app or website means you fully accept these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.

sections.heading: Description of Service
sections.body: NEXUS is a fitness and gym-management platform offering personalized workout and nutrition plans, an AI-powered coach, and tools for gym and coach management.

sections.heading: User Accounts
sections.body: You are responsible for the accuracy of the information you provide and for keeping your login credentials confidential. Notify us immediately if you suspect any unauthorized use of your account.

sections.heading: Subscriptions & Payments
sections.body: Some features require a paid subscription processed through Stripe. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled before the end of the current billing cycle. Refunds are at the discretion of your gym or coach unless otherwise stated.

sections.heading: Acceptable Use
sections.body: You may not use the app for any unlawful purpose, attempt unauthorized access to our systems, or impersonate a coach or gym owner without authorization.

sections.heading: Medical Disclaimer
sections.body: Content provided in NEXUS (workout plans, nutrition plans, and AI Coach recommendations) is for general guidance only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Consult your doctor before starting any new exercise program, especially if you have an existing health condition.

sections.heading: Content & Intellectual Property
sections.body: All content, trademarks, and app design are owned by or licensed to NEXUS and may not be copied or redistributed without prior written permission.

sections.heading: Limitation of Liability
sections.body: The service is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We are not liable for any injury or damage resulting from the use of workout or nutrition plans without appropriate professional supervision where needed.

sections.heading: Termination
sections.body: We may suspend or terminate your account if you violate these terms. You may also stop using the service and delete your account at any time.

sections.heading: Changes to These Terms
sections.body: We may update these terms periodically. Continued use of the app after any change constitutes your acceptance of the updated terms.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.body: For any legal inquiry, reach out via the email address at the bottom of this page.

deleteAccount.metaDescription: How to delete your account and data from the NEXUS app.
deleteAccount.title: Delete Your Account
deleteAccount.intro: We respect your right to delete your NEXUS account and data at any time.

steps.title: From within the app
steps.body: Open the NEXUS app → Settings → Account → Delete Account → confirm the deletion. Your data is removed within minutes.

steps.title: If you can't access your account
steps.body: Email us from the address registered on your account requesting deletion, and we'll process your request within 30 days at most.

deleteAccount.dataRemoved: Your profile, workout and nutrition plans, progress and measurement history, messages and conversations, and any photos you've uploaded.
deleteAccount.dataRetained: Billing and payment records may be kept for an additional period to comply with accounting and tax obligations, even after account deletion.
deleteAccount.timeframe: Deletion requests are processed within 30 business days at most.
